method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed building frame. No flattening. Two-meter sampling oversamples the coarse mixed-source DEM.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Approximate global viewer terrain; not surveyed urban foundation levels. Vegetation and urban surface returns can affect the field.
reviewDatumBasis: One unchanged standard host sample outside the SSE entrance annex [.7,12.5]. Raw tiles,grid andPNG unchanged. The named station elevation5068m is separate from host samples andis not asserted tobe a surveyed headhouse floor.
